test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rajat joined school on 26th February 2020, a Wednesday, and he has his examination scheduled on 26th May 2020. There was no holiday or leave, except Sundays. For how many active working days did he go to school before the exam?
solution:
Number of days starting from 26th February 2020 to 26th May 2020 = February (4) + March (31) + April (30) + May (25) = 90 days** as 2020 is a leap year.**

26th February is held on Wednesday. So 26 February (Wednesday) + 4 = 1 March (Sunday)

Since it was Sunday on 1st March, every 7th day from 1st March will be a Sunday

Total number of Sundays from 26th February 2020 to 26th May 2020 = March (5) + April (4) + May (4) = 13 

Total number of working days = Total number of days - Total number of Sundays = 90 - 13 = 77

Therefore, there are** 77 active working days.**

**Hence, the correct answer is "77".**
